identification: Cast brass leaping jaguar bonnet mascot, about 20 cm long, with a round mounting cup under the forepaws. Polished or stripped brass (no chrome left), pitting and verdigris at paws, eyes and mouth. No maker's mark visible. Could be a stripped 1950s Jaguar (Wilmot Breeden type) leaper or a later brass copy; cannot tell from photos.
